style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: timetable board and timeline: kraft paper keys with a marker-magenta Enter

images.why: Look 'a departure board beside it' that 'lists times to change from one clock to the other': each listed time is a blank train ticket (a train timetable, per the teaching context), the times are code
images.prompt: A single railway train ticket card: warm cream-yellow thick card stock, a plain dark orange band down the left edge, one small round punched hole, softly rounded corners, the rest of the ticket completely blank and smooth.

images.why: Opening 'the marker stands on the noon post': the noon post under its sun
images.prompt: A bright round sun: a perfectly smooth, plain golden-orange glowing ball with nothing drawn on it, a soft warm glow ring and short rounded rays all around it.

images.why: Opening 'the left-hand midnight post is lit': the midnight post under its moon
images.prompt: A round full moon in warm pale yellow with a slightly deeper golden rim and a few soft shallow golden-brown craters.
